title: RWB-E4-002 on rwb-valuation: table ownership, trigger and the view read path are fixed by no single source
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md, RWB-E4-002; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD S1 Valuation and route v3.md A2.2; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD S1 Valuation and route v2.md T3.1, T-A.2; _work/msr/context/S1.md ownership rows; Template and Rules §R5.5 DP-05
description: Four values the split needs are stated by no single source and disagree where they are stated. (1) Table ownership: the S1 context pack lists REST operations, events, jobs and the RouteDecisionWorkflow but no table, while the legacy story writes valuation_ext with DF-EXT-036 to DF-EXT-049 and TSD S1 T3.1 gives a valuation object with DF-COL-018 to DF-COL-044. (2) Trigger: the FSD says the feature receives 'a completed ACE batch, an event or a timer', but the S1 ownership rows give the service no event and no job, so no schedule or event exists for the receipt. (3) View read: DP-05 allows reading through rwb-source-data's contract or the service's own ACE views, the FSD and the legacy story read recovery.v_ace_valuation and v_ace_batch_status directly, and Architecture v5 says the v_ace_* views are read only by rwb-source-data. (4) Operation attribution: the S1 ownership rows carry three provided operations and the legacy story names only POST /cases/{caseId}/route.
evidence: Legacy data row: 'valuation_ext | valuation_key, accepted, accepted_at, accepted_by, stale_flag, age_days and 8 more | DF-EXT-036 to DF-EXT-049'. Context pack: 'Ownership rows owned by S1 / Tables (0) - None'; 'Events (0)'; 'Jobs (0)'. FSD S1 A2.2.2 step 1: 'Receives its trigger: a completed ACE batch, an event or a timer'. FSD S1 A2.2.2 integration points: 'ACE (v_ace_valuation; SVAF ingested by ACE)'.
owner_role: Solution architect, S1; data owner of rwb-valuation; owner of the ACE view catalogue
proposed: valuation_ext is created and owned in rwb_valuation by this story keyed on valuation_key, with stale_flag and age_days written at receipt and the acceptance trio left to FEAT-VAL-04; the appraisal facts are read SELECT-only from recovery.v_ace_valuation and never copied; the receipt runs inside the route assessment on POST /cases/{caseId}/route with no Schedule, the batch leg being the freshness gate on v_ace_batch_status; the two asset valuation operations belong to the sibling valuation keys. Confirm the S1 table row and the view grant before wave 3 starts.

title: RWB-E4-002 contract on rwb-valuation: valuation_ext field list, element nesting, 409 and 404 wording, retention and publication coordinates are stated by no source
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD S1 Valuation and route v2.md T-A.1, T-A.2, T3.0, T3.1; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md RWB-E4-002 data and validation rows; Template and Rules §R7.2 s12
section: 7 Acceptance criteria; 11 Data; 13 Solution plan; 14 Validation and messages
description: The contract can publish the path, the entity names RouteRequest and Approval, the error statuses and the seven standard record columns from the TSD, and the valuation_ext field identifiers DF-EXT-036 to DF-EXT-049 from the legacy data row, but no source states: the physical type of each valuation_ext column beyond the TSD's valuation types; how the appraisal elements sit inside the Approval answer (flat or grouped); the wording of the 404 and the 409 and the exact cause of the 409; the retention and archive rule of a valuation_ext row; and the artefact coordinates and publication channel of the contract. The legacy data row also says 'and 8 more' for valuation_ext without naming them.
evidence: TSD S1 T-A.2 fixes purpose, request RouteRequest, response Approval, errors 401, 403, 404, 409, 422, 503 and the Idempotency-Key header, and no message text. Legacy validation row lists MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003 only. Legacy data row: 'valuation_ext | ... and 8 more'. No source read for this key states a retention rule.
owner_role: Contract author, S1; platform API owner; solution architect, S1
proposed: Publish v1 with the appraisal elements as one flat group inside Approval, the valuation_ext types taken from TSD S1 T3.1 where the two rows name the same column, the 404 and 409 wordings left as messageId slots, the retention rule recorded as an open P3 item, and the artefact published through the platform registry the other service contracts use.
